patch_list: Stops the ad SDKs from starting with the app, turns off Firebase Analytics and removes the advertising ID permissions. Also applies "Remove ads". Notifications keep working.
Removes the banner and full-screen ads. No ads are loaded and the ad consent popup is skipped.
Adds a floating button on the game screen that opens a list of all possible moves.
